race.title: Limerick (Ladies Pro/Am) Flat Race
race.verdict: MARBLE HILL sets the standard for an in-form yard so there's lots to like. Todo Bien is sure to pose a threat if returning to something like his debut form, while Fred Mooser is a noteworthy newcomer. MARBLE HILL (FR) TODO BIEN (IRE) FRED MOOSER (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Marble Hill (15/8), Todo Bien (11/4), Native Deal (11/2), Some See Stars (6/1), Tlc Gold (8/1), Fred Mooser (14/1), Hoof And Hustle (16/1), Cant Stopthe Clock (20/1), Moot Hall (33/1), Heartbreak Prince (33/1), Allez Yeats (50/1), Mister Bec (100/1)
